title: Commercial air systems: filtration, efficiency and maintenance
summary: Well-maintained filtration cuts energy waste and extends HVAC equipment life.
paragraphs: In commercial buildings, air-handling units often run for long hours under changing loads. Dirty or poorly matched filters raise pressure drop, so fans use more energy and systems wear faster.
Planned filter changes, pressure checks and periodic system reviews are a simple way to keep comfort high and operating costs down.
BasicAir supplies filters and maintenance support for offices, hotels and retail air systems.
